styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has 12 visible tones per tile against 17 for the cheese stall and 20 for the roofed well, so it sits below the richer references and only above the hedge (9). They lack the 5-6 step ramps, per-surface grain and speckle that the stall and well show. The piece is clean and readable but looks thinner and flatter than the references.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is an arcade cabinet twin. Measured facts: 12 visible tones per tile, against 17-20 for the stall and well and 9 for the hedge.
